rationale: Generic swapchain-timing work in the Dawn GpuSurface. resize() records the requested size and begin_frame() configures the swapchain at most once, before it acquires the texture, so a live resize that delivers many size events per frame rebuilds the swapchain once; a zero dimension skips the frame. Pulp-owned tests count the configures with a header-only SwapchainResizeState and on a real CAMetalLayer. Pulp continues to own these targets under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits the render change when the targets adopt the Vellum package (change event 20261024-render-swapchain-lazy-configure). No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
